_: Every environment variable the Python gateway and autopilot-api read, against the Go gateway's (docs/admin/go-gateway-env.md is generated from this file by tools/gen_gateway_env_table.py). class: same | new (Go only) | not_carried (Python reads, Go does not: say why) | refused (both refuse it) | retired (renamed, both refuse the old name) | kubelet (set on the pod, read by no process). python/go: the processes that read it (serve, api, migrate). deployed: the Python Deployment sets it today (apron templates/55-autopilot/gateway). example: a value the test gives it.

vars.name: GATEWAY_DSN
vars.note: The writer's DSN (the database owner's).

vars.name: CLEARANCE_CORE_URL
vars.note: Plain http is accepted for the core (it is a Service on the cluster network).

vars.name: CLEARANCE_CORE_TOKEN_FILE
vars.note: Default /var/run/secrets/tokens/clearance.

vars.name: CLEARANCE_CORE_TIMEOUT
vars.note: Seconds per attempt, 0.05 to 30.

vars.name: CLEARANCE_API_URL
vars.note: Named in /v1/contract. Go's serve also reads it (optional, Go-only): a Preflight score reads the paths a run's writes touched from clearance-api's outcome records with the caller's bearer token, and is refused (503) while it is unset. serve needs https unless CLEARANCE_API_ALLOW_HTTP=1; api only names it in /v1/contract and sends no token, so it keeps accepting http.

vars.name: AUTOPILOT_RUN_AUDIENCES
vars.note: Default autopilot.

vars.name: AUTOPILOT_AGENTS_DIR
vars.note: Default /app/agents (the image carries them).

vars.name: AUTOPILOT_DELEGATES
vars.note: Go refuses `*`, a leading wildcard and a wildcard namespace (stricter; Python takes any glob).

vars.name: AUTOPILOT_GATEWAY_VERSION
vars.note: Set by the image (the release tag).

vars.name: AUTOPILOT_OIDC_ISSUER
vars.note: Go checks the issuer's key URL is https unless AUTOPILOT_JWKS_ALLOW_HTTP=1.

vars.name: BACKSTAGE_URL
vars.note: Go needs https unless BACKSTAGE_ALLOW_HTTP=1.

vars.name: ARGO_SYNC_ENABLED
vars.note: Go needs ARGO_ENABLED (Python ignores it when Argo reads are off).

vars.name: GLIDEPATH_API_URL
vars.note: Go needs https unless GLIDEPATH_API_ALLOW_HTTP=1.

vars.name: GITHUB_PR_ENABLED
vars.note: Go also needs BROKER_URL, GITHUB_OWNERS and (it turns the Agent XR loader on) AGENT_XRS_NAMESPACES.

vars.name: BROKER_URL
vars.note: Python's default names a lab Service; Go has no default and needs https unless BROKER_ALLOW_HTTP=1.

vars.name: AIRFRAME_UPPER_CLUSTERS
vars.note: Python's default is hangar-prod.

vars.name: RECONCILE_WINDOW_HOURS
vars.note: Go allows at most 720 (its ledger's retention); Python allows 744.

vars.name: METRICS_PORT
vars.note: The api serves no metrics (Python's does not either).

vars.name: GATEWAY_API_DSN
vars.note: Go refuses to start on a role that could write (CheckRole).

vars.name: GATEWAY_API_AUDITORS
vars.note: Go refuses a catch-all glob.

vars.name: GATEWAY_API_NOTIFIERS
vars.note: Go refuses a catch-all glob.

vars.name: GATEWAY_API_TABLES
vars.note: Retired at R-4 in both: only `gateway` is accepted.

vars.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT
vars.note: Go needs https unless OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ALLOW_HTTP=1.

vars.name: GATEWAY_CONFORMANCE_CONTROL
vars.note: Test-only control interface; off unless set.

vars.name: POD_NAMESPACE
vars.note: Substituted by the kubelet into OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES ($(POD_NAMESPACE)); no process reads it.

vars.name: POD_NAME
vars.note: Substituted by the kubelet into OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES ($(POD_NAME)); no process reads it.

vars.name: GITHUB_OWNERS
vars.note: The GitHub owners the pull requests go to (no argument chooses one). Required with GITHUB_PR_ENABLED.

vars.name: AIRFRAME_OWNER
vars.note: Owner of the tenants repository and the apps' repositories (Python assumes one lab user). One of GITHUB_OWNERS.

vars.name: AGENT_XRS_NAMESPACES
vars.note: The namespaces whose Agent XRs may define agents. Required when the loader is on (Python reads every namespace).

vars.name: AGENT_XRS_NAMES
vars.note: Agents whose names do not start with their app: name=namespace.

vars.name: AGENT_XRS_TOOLS
vars.note: Tools a pin may hold beyond the default set.

vars.name: AGENT_XRS_MAX_TIER
vars.note: T0, T1 or T2 (default T2).

vars.name: GLIDEPATH_API_ALLOW_HTTP
vars.note: Plain http to glidepath-api (default off).

vars.name: BROKER_ALLOW_HTTP
vars.note: Plain http to the installation-token broker (default off).

vars.name: CLEARANCE_API_ALLOW_HTTP
vars.note: Plain http to clearance-api, where a Preflight score reads the paths a run touched with the caller's token (default off). Not read by api.

vars.name: BACKSTAGE_ALLOW_HTTP
vars.note: Plain http to the catalog (default off).

vars.name: AUTOPILOT_JWKS_ALLOW_HTTP
vars.note: Plain http to an OIDC or Tower key set (default off).

vars.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ALLOW_HTTP
vars.note: Plain http to the log collector (default off).

vars.name: XR_REGIONS
vars.note: What xr.request may ask for (Python bounds nothing; each has a safe default).

vars.name: XR_VPC_CIDRS
vars.note: What xr.request may ask for (Python bounds nothing; each has a safe default).

vars.name: XR_SLACK_CHANNELS
vars.note: What xr.request may ask for (Python bounds nothing; each has a safe default).

vars.name: XR_MAX_DB_STORAGE_GIB
vars.note: What xr.request may ask for (Python bounds nothing; each has a safe default).

vars.name: XR_MAX_CONSUMERS
vars.note: What xr.request may ask for (Python bounds nothing; each has a safe default).

vars.name: XR_ALLOW_UNPROTECTED_DB
vars.note: What xr.request may ask for (Python bounds nothing; each has a safe default).

vars.name: XR_ALLOW_EMPTY_ON_DELETE
vars.note: What xr.request may ask for (Python bounds nothing; each has a safe default).

vars.name: GATEWAY_ALLOW_MISSING_INDEXES
vars.note: Start although the read API's six indexes are missing (default off: serve and api refuse and name `autopilot-gateway migrate`).

vars.name: MIGRATE_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
vars.note: `migrate` only (default 5).

vars.name: MIGRATE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
vars.note: `migrate` only (default 900).

vars.name: CLEARANCE_CORE_TOKEN
vars.note: A literal token for the local smoke tools (engine/core.py local_core): never a deployment. The Go gateway reads CLEARANCE_CORE_TOKEN_FILE only.

vars.name: CLEARANCE_TOKEN
vars.note: The test MCP server's token provider (engine/server.py): never a deployment.

vars.name: AUTOPILOT_EPHEMERAL
vars.note: An in-memory store, local runs only: Go refuses it (no memory store). Python's api sets it for its own config parse and ignores the environment's.
